name: app-heart-rate-chart-component-beside-hand-held-analytics-phone
title: Heart Rate Chart Component beside Analytics Phone
whatItIs: Two rounded white panels: one enlarging a heart rate card with a stepped red line chart, dotted forecast and time ruler, the other showing the same card in a hand-held analytics phone in a dark hand.
whatItMeans: Enlarging the component beside the phone shows detail and context together.
techniques: Stepped line with a dotted projection
Red marker dot at the current value
Time ruler with tick marks under the chart
Component shown large beside the full screen

vocabulary.definition: A dotted continuation of a line showing a prediction.
A tick-mark scale beneath a chart's time axis.
A UI piece shown large next to its screen.
